title: Stucco at base of wall with weep screed

checklist.item: A weep screed is at the base, at least 4 in (100 mm) above earth and 2 in (50 mm) above paving.
checklist.why: Stucco is a reservoir cladding; the screed is where it drains.

checklist.item: The water barrier (two layers or a drainage layer over wood sheathing) laps over the weep screed flange.
checklist.why: A barrier behind the flange sends water into the wall.

checklist.item: Control joints, their spacing and the lath treatment behind them are shown.
checklist.why: Uncontrolled stucco cracks, and cracks let water in.

checklist.item: Stucco thickness, coats and lath attachment are noted.
checklist.why: Thin stucco cracks and fails its fire rating.

checklist.item: Stucco stops above flashing at openings and roofs with a casing bead and a gap.
checklist.why: Stucco bedded onto flashing wicks water.

checklist.item: Finish, colour coat and sealant at dissimilar materials are noted.
